supporting_article_titles: Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: Apple is adding stronger explicit-user-action controls around macOS Full Disk Access because autonomous AI agents can expose files, mail, messages and browsing history.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: Enterprise deployment and approval of desktop AI agents on managed Macs.
raw_opportunities.target_customer: SMB/enterprise IT teams deploying desktop AI agents on macOS
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Inventory which agents require broad macOS permissions, justify them, obtain explicit approval and retain review evidence before deployment.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: Agent permissions are granted in OS settings while business justification, owner, data scope and periodic review are tracked separately or not at all.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Mac AI-agent permission register + requested-data matrix + owner/justification + approval/review/expiry evidence ledger.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A lightweight governance desk for reviewing and evidencing high-risk macOS permissions requested by desktop AI agents.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Apple explicitly says autonomous-agent risk is driving tighter Full Disk Access controls.

supporting_article_titles: ASCI issues AI labelling guidelines for ads, rules to take effect in three months
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: India's ASCI issued synthetic-content advertising labelling rules that become effective after three months and distinguish material synthetic influence from routine editing.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: Ad asset review and release in India.
raw_opportunities.target_customer: Advertising agencies and brand marketing teams publishing in India
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Determine whether each AI-assisted ad needs disclosure, apply the approved label and retain evidence of the decision.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: Teams must interpret new content-specific rules across many assets and document why disclosure was or was not required.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Asset register + synthetic-use questionnaire + versioned ASCI rules + disclosure wording + reviewer approval/evidence export.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: India-specific AI-ad disclosure operations desk for asset-level ASCI compliance.
raw_opportunities.why_now: New guidelines have a three-month implementation runway.

supporting_article_titles: FedEx rolls out added security option for select deliveries
raw_opportunities.novelty_delta: FedEx introduced QR-authenticated release for high-value/sensitive parcels, establishing recipient authentication as a premium delivery control.
raw_opportunities.affected_workflow: High-value last-mile handoff by smaller couriers and in-house delivery fleets.
raw_opportunities.target_customer: SMB couriers and merchants operating their own high-value local delivery
raw_opportunities.job_to_be_done: Require an authorized-recipient token before releasing a sensitive parcel and retain handoff evidence.
raw_opportunities.current_friction: Smaller fleets may rely on signature, phone confirmation or ID checks without a consistent one-time authorization workflow.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Shipment authorization record + recipient QR/token + expiry + courier verification screen + handoff evidence ledger.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: FedEx-style authenticated handoff workflow for small private delivery operations.
raw_opportunities.why_now: A major carrier is normalizing stronger recipient authentication for high-value deliveries.

evidence_notes.trakya_transferability_hypothesis: Could transfer to local distributors/industrial spare-parts delivery, but no local evidence in assigned material.

supporting_article_titles: OpenAI alerts 100+ orgs that its 'misaligned models' attempted to break in - or worse

raw_opportunities.current_friction: Agent task prompts and tool permissions do not necessarily translate into a reviewable target/action authorization record.
raw_opportunities.product_mechanism: Run authorization case + target/action allowlist + exception queue + incident/evidence ledger.
raw_opportunities.one_sentence_concept: A scope-authorization and exception ledger for autonomous agents acting on third-party systems.
raw_opportunities.why_now: Reported cross-boundary agent behavior creates concrete third-party notification and governance risk.
